assessment: Current source plus conservative deployed metadata inventory; no runtime observation performed
binaryEvidence: The headless survey writes binary-references.json; stage0.py pin records exact deployment/source hashes after the recorded Release build

surfaces.destination: process memory
surfaces.finding: DI composes simulation services; scene, results, calibration and themes are in-memory. The only Studio save/export entry point is the user-confirmed report export (app-report-export); nothing else is saved.

surfaces.destination: the path the user confirms in the OS save dialog, plus its declared sidecars <name>.scene.json (every format) and <name>.meta.json (event CSV); defaults to the Documents folder, no folder or setting remembered
surfaces.finding: Export… in the export popup (Export.Confirm) opens the save dialog; only after the user confirms a path (and, once, any existing sidecars it would replace) does ReportFileWriter open, truncate and write exactly the chosen file and its sidecars, restoring or deleting them on a failed write. No other Studio type references a file-writing API (SurfaceSurveyTests checks the deployed IL against writerTypes).
surfaces.residualRisk: Writes, and on confirmation replaces, user-chosen files; a failed write rolls back to the previous bytes.
surfaces.runtime: observed by ReportExportScenarioTests runs 3–6 on 2026-10-15, writing into owned sandboxes only the declared files

surfaces.destination: <deployment>/ambient/terrestrial-unscear2000-v1.json
surfaces.finding: Loader reads the deployed spectrum and validates its hash. TEMP redirection does not change this path.

surfaces.destination: Gcam.Studio.Services assembly resource
surfaces.finding: Read-only compiled resource; no external file/network fetch.

surfaces.destination: caller-supplied paths in CLI/study APIs, not exposed by Studio
surfaces.finding: These APIs exist in deployed assemblies. Current Studio composition does not expose their save/study/vector-load entry points; metadata references alone do not prove reachability.

surfaces.destination: none declared by reachable Studio services; any environment-resolved writes would use redirected paths
surfaces.finding: Current managed Studio source has no file-writing logger/cache or frame-export path. Framework/native effects are separate unknown surfaces below.

surfaces.destination: none declared
surfaces.finding: No reachable send, launch, clipboard or hardware SDK call is declared by current Studio source; attributed traffic or child launch is out of declaration.

surfaces.destination: owned window and shared interactive session
surfaces.finding: Window creation/display, caption actions and DWM theme attributes; not persistent OS theme settings.

surfaces.actor: Studio process (Windows text-input framework on the Studio UI thread)
surfaces.destination: HKCU/Software/Microsoft/CTF/CUAS/DefaultCompositionWindow, values Left and Top (run user's hive only)
surfaces.decision: E1 (author 2026-10-14, option 2: allow by declaration; HUM-07 with the next run's approval)
evidence: observed run probe-20261014-04 (local trace, retained under A4)
surfaces.finding: Two SetValue events at window close on the UI thread: the text-input framework persists the default composition-window position. An app effect inside this declared surface; any other CTF key, value, operation or hive stays out of declaration.
surfaces.residualRisk: The user's IME composition-window position is updated.

surfaces.actor: Studio process (in-process GPU user-mode driver during WPF hardware-render setup)
surfaces.destination: <ProgramData>/NVIDIA Corporation/Drs/nvAppTimestamps (ProgramData known folder); write-only-within-file
surfaces.decision: E3 (author 2026-10-14, option 2: allow by declaration; HUM-07 with the next run's approval)
evidence: observed run probe-20261014-04 (local trace, retained under A4)
surfaces.finding: 8-byte WriteFile into the existing file by a driver thread created by the WPF render thread. Only WriteFile at this exact path is declared; create, delete, rename or set-information on it stays out of declaration.
surfaces.residualRisk: The driver's per-application timestamp store (machine-wide) is updated.

surfaces.destination: OS/user registry; not redirected by environment variables
surfaces.finding: Source survey cannot establish registry absence. Effects issued in the Studio process by WPF/CLR/native code are app effects whichever layer issues them; only the declared surfaces above are allowed, everything else observed stays out of declaration or unknown until an approved rule covers it.

surfaces.destination: framework-resolved known folders or OS-managed locations; unmeasured
surfaces.finding: Known-folder resolution does not inherit APPDATA redirection in every API. No disposable environment is assumed.

surfaces.destination: OS policy-controlled, not necessarily <runRoot>
surfaces.finding: No app-specific dump writer; OS/runtime crash handling and telemetry are not proven absent by managed metadata.

surfaces.destination: <runRoot>, <recordRoot>
surfaces.finding: Fresh marked folders, confined paths, exact five-key launch allow-list; diagnostics retained without deletes.

surfaces.destination: <recordRoot>/manifest.json, ui-manifest.json, tree.txt, window.png, attempt.mp4, attempt.vtt, video-status.json
surfaces.finding: Schema-1 diagnostics plus final UI adapter. Failure images remain diagnostic; P4 quality gates are separate. Every recording attempt (also a failed test's) stays here with its status file.

surfaces.actor: harness (test process recorder threads, not Studio)
surfaces.destination: <repository>/artifacts/ui-videos/<case-id>.mp4, <case-id>.vtt, index.json and their same-folder staging copies *.tmp (git-ignored); not written with GCAM_UI_VIDEO=0
surfaces.finding: Only after a test's final verdict is a pass: each file is copied to a staging name in the destination folder and replaced on its own, MP4 then VTT then index.json last; a failed, skipped or aborted test leaves the folder unchanged. Captures pixels only of the owned Studio frame (foreign windows masked, native save dialog neutral). Outside the temporary roots, so an observed batch lists it as harness-owned.
surfaces.residualRisk: Repository-local derived files; removed by git clean -fdx; a run in a worktree writes into that worktree.

surfaces.destination: docs/assets/studio-polish-survey and docs/assets/studio-desktop-imaging.png
surfaces.finding: Existing explicitly invoked survey/README fixture writes repository assets. The first probe never invokes these scenarios.

surfaces.destination: registered Studio deployment, read-only git queries
surfaces.finding: Direct launch ledger/marker, unowned same-name refusal, graceful owned close, no force kill or restart adoption.

surfaces.destination: <leaseRoot>
surfaces.finding: Exclusive handle with owner/session/expiry; finally releases, a live handle cannot be stolen by expiry.

surfaces.destination: owned Studio controls/window and shared pointer
surfaces.finding: Default-deny semantic targets and exact-match lookup. First probe performs no UIA discovery or pointer input.

surfaces.destination: owned instance gcam-<run-id> and <traceRoot>/probe.etl
surfaces.finding: Prepared only. Machine-wide raw events remain local; output/temp redirection and named-instance stop are explicit. ETW engine's OS bookkeeping is not claimed confined to scratch.

surfaces.destination: selected HKCU reads and <traceRoot>/fallback-*.json
surfaces.finding: Prepared only, not invoked headlessly. Observations are diagnostic, with transient/attribution/channel blind spots; no registry write or network connection is generated.

surfaces.destination: repository bin/obj, owned temporary gcam-* fixtures/results, NuGet cache
surfaces.finding: Headless validation effects, not Studio effects. Build/test host native OS effects are outside the claimed product survey and raw trace filtering must keep actors separate.

surfaces.destination: HKCU/Software/GcamUiaProbe/<run-id>, REG_SZ RunId=<run-id>
surfaces.finding: A2: once after trace-ready, before Studio launch. Native create disposition refuses an existing key without overwriting its value. Exact key/run identity and harness actor form the registry positive control. No registry marker deletion; every cleanup requires author approval. A3: other candidates remain unknown pending individually approved rules. A4: retain local traces/run folders until the edition is accepted.
surfaces.runtime: not observed; headless tests use a fake only

qualification: G1 blocked: unknown framework/OS surfaces remain; run 04 still has out-of-declaration and unknown Studio-tree candidates (see the draft charter)
